Authority.description:
The authority having jurisdiction is an organisation, not an officer (SCC IB-2026-10-16).

`first_nation`, `federal`, `outside_alberta` and `unconfirmed` name who decides where the Safety Codes Act
variance does not, or where Batatis has not confirmed it; those packs are never `full` coverage.

The benchmark acceptable solution: the quoted Division B sentence the design departs from,
a one-line departure the applicant confirms, and its objective and function codes by lookup.

Bulletin.description: A Safety Codes Council information bulletin. Title, date and link; paragraphs are not copied.

matches_case_provisions.description: A provision the package varies is among the case provisions.

CloseOut.description:
Close-out after a final decision.

An administrative acceptance is not a variance: it only says the file is complete. The copy to the
Council is due within 10 days of the variance being issued, which happens outside Batatis and which
the officer records (`issued_on`). Before that, and after a refusal, nothing is due.

notice.default: Batatis does not send anything to the Safety Codes Council. The officer sends the copy and records it here.
notice.title: Notice

CloseOut.title: CloseOut

notice.default: This review lists administrative gaps only. It is not a finding that the design is safe, that it complies with the code, or that a variance is granted.
notice.title: Notice

ConditionAnswer.description: The applicant's latest answer to one condition, read from case facts. Never a determination.
ConditionAnswer.title: ConditionAnswer

expected_version.description: Required for an acceptance and a refusal; the displayed saved application version.
expected_version.title: Expected Version

Disposition.description:
The officer's call on one automated finding, kept with the session. It never edits the finding.

Absent means the default: `ask` for an applicant finding the review established, `verify` for a
not-found or officer-routed one. `dismissed` needs a reason; the note is optional.
Disposition.title: Disposition

DocumentReview.description:
What the model read across every readable page, kept only where it checks out against the text.

Facts, conflicts and cited provisions carry excerpts that occur in the named page. Missing items,
questions and flags are Batatis's own words and never say that a design complies, is safe or is approved.
DocumentReview.title: DocumentReview

EvidenceRef.description: An exact excerpt of the request or of one page of an attached file, checked against that text.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

Explainer.description: Short note on a Section C row. A quote is copied from codedb; the note never finds compliance.
Explainer.title: Explainer

ExportPreview.description: The draft export for the application screen: its exact bytes and images of its first pages.
ExportPreview.title: ExportPreview

ExportPreviewTooLarge.description: The draft PDF alone is too large to send as a preview, so none of it is sent; download the draft.
ExportPreviewTooLarge.title: ExportPreviewTooLarge

FactPointer.description:
One extracted fact and where it sits. `start`/`end` index the source text: the description,
or the page text of `page` (text layer order). Form values have no span.
FactPointer.title: FactPointer

FieldConflict.description: The text gives two different values for one field, so neither was stored. The planner asks.
FieldConflict.title: FieldConflict

FieldReading.description: One form or record field. `blank` is certain; `not_found` means ask the officer to look.
FieldReading.title: FieldReading

Fork.description: Acceptable-solution path or alternative-solution path, read early (before Section C).

Guide.description: A published guide for a design category or process. Guidance, not a variance or an approval.

officer's call on findings. `findings` lists changes only; findings left out keep their state.

PreApplication.description: 'Before you submit': meet the authority having jurisdiction and emergency services early.
